title: On the Prowl
author: Chris Page
notes: The Caller's Box 10626, permission: full. The acceptance set's timing dance and its ricochet: a mad robin in three beats, a promenade in two, a shoulder round in three, and a hey that ricochets on the seventh pass and ends short on the eighth.

source.transcript:
A1  (3) Mad robin clockwise 1/2 around neighbor  (2) Single file promenade clockwise 1/4  (3) Partner right shoulder round 1/2  (8) Partner swing
A2  (3) Mad robin clockwise 1/2 around partner  (2) Single file promenade clockwise 1/4  (3) Neighbor right shoulder round 1/2  (8) Neighbor swing
B1  (8) In long lines, go forward and back  (8) Ladies chain to partner
B2  (16) Ricochet hey (WR;NL;MR;PL;WR;NL;M ricochet;NL~)

figures.call: MAD ROBIN HALF WAY AROUND YOUR NEIGHBOUR
HALF A RIGHT SHOULDER ROUND WITH YOUR PARTNER
MAD ROBIN HALF WAY AROUND YOUR PARTNER
HALF A RIGHT SHOULDER ROUND WITH YOUR NEIGHBOUR

params.passes: RR NL LR PL RR NL L! NL~
